limitations: Credentials, raw prompts, machine paths, Session IDs, Run IDs, and API keys are intentionally excluded.
Usage and cost fields remain disabled until their provider semantics are independently verified.
Native session/resume is unsupported by Grok 0.2.118; cold continuity is qualified only as exact-ID session/load HistoryRestore.
Compaction detection is best-effort and fail-closed. The internal debug arm is acceptance-only and is not exposed as a product capability or user setting.
Grok ignores ACP Session mcpServers; External MCP therefore uses a private process plugin-dir and rotates Host compatibility when the full server set changes.
Grok itself does not load .env files; Rovai resolves only environment names referenced by the official config and injects them into the Grok child process.
Provider text emitted as ordinary ACP agent_message_chunk is not classified or cleaned by Rovai and can therefore appear in execution evidence and final publication.

Account cached-token authentication was not exercised because this host has no existing Grok login; health and AgentRun select only advertised non-interactive methods and never initiate interactive login.
